import java.util.*;

public class CodeforcesDiv2_630_E {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long L = sc.nextLong();
        long R = sc.nextLong();
        
        long totalNumbers = R - L + 1;
        long oddCount = (L % 2 == 1) ? (totalNumbers + 1) / 2 : totalNumbers / 2;
        long evenCount = totalNumbers - oddCount;
        
        long totalCells = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(exponentiate(oddCount + evenCount, totalCells));
        } else {
            long result = (exponentiate(oddCount, totalCells) + exponentiate(evenCount, totalCells)) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long exponentiate(long base, long exponent) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
